A '''individual''' was [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum's]] two terms ended in [[992 BBY]]. Valorum had made extensive preparations for her to take over his work of bettering the Republic for its people.<ref name="Rule of Two" />
